facts.fact: 闪婚过教堂：神父坚持结婚预告三遍，Ulises 谎称 Las Tunas 法官已公证——神父被吓破例主婚
facts.anchor: the judge in Las Tunas had already married them in a civil ceremony

facts.fact: 婚宴：Inés 赶制浅紫礼服；Cándido 冷淡道贺并确认自己继续替 Perla 收账（枕头下手枪是威慑）
facts.anchor: the memory of the pistol he kept under his pillow served to facilitate their cooperation

facts.fact: 婚后分房照旧（他睡原房间），夜里溜进她被窝；镇上改称她「Inclán Arnao de Linares 夫人」
广场财政战：他要账户加名/卖器材/开影楼，她拒绝——「去找份工作」「别想动我的钱」
facts.anchor: “But don’t start thinking you’ll open a fancy studio with my money.”

facts.fact: 闪回：Encarnación 私奔一月后父亲中风；母亲靠鸦片酊度日；战后挂牌开客栈
facts.anchor: His heart is rent in two from grief and worry and shame

facts.fact: 父亲当着 Cándido 宣告：死前女儿嫁人=剥夺继承权——锁死 Perla 婚事、吓退求婚者
facts.anchor: If she marries before I pass away, she will be disinherited

facts.fact: 章末：Encarnación 拎行李箱回来，裙摆后躲着黑卷发小女孩（Inés 登场）
facts.anchor: Hiding behind Encarnación’s skirts there is a girl with black curls.
